crossRefs.note: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,
Who is this who comes from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? Who is this who is glorious in his clothing, marching…
You shall speak to him, saying, ‘Yahweh says, “Have you killed and also taken possession?” ’ You shall speak to him…
They washed the chariot by the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood where the prostitutes washed…
He said, “Throw her down!” So they threw her down; and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses.…
I saw an angel standing in the sun. He cried with a loud voice, saying to all the birds that fly in the sky, “Come! Be…

translations.web: that you may crush them, dipping your foot in blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies.”
translations.bsb: that your foot may be dipped in the blood of your foes— the tongues of your dogs in the same.”
translations.kjv: That thy foot may be dipped in the blood of thine enemies, and the tongue of thy dogs
translations.asv: That thou mayest crush them, dipping thy foot in blood, That the tongue of thy dogs may have its portion from thine enemies.
